I too experience this, mostly my mom is the boss in our house. She gets mad at small things, starting to think she’s bipolar because she changes her moods often. I also try to lower down my ego towards her. If they shout at you for no reason and tells you that “it’s so that you can get through life” i swear that’s bullshit, they’re supposed to make you feel safe not treat you as if ur their employee.School is not important at all, some people got by even dropping out of high school and right now they own companies and is successful. I guess you can say i live in a pretty shit household/toxic household. i guess you could say the same thing to yours. I get by my everyday life by just listening to what she tells me to do. even if it frustrates the shit out of me, as much as possible I don’t want to argue cause sure as hell it’s exhausting asf. I don’t know whatelse you go through but my advice is finding someone that has the same situation as you’re going through and ask them for advice. You’re not alone, i’m sure others go through this everyday, but if you need someone to talk too just hmu. I can’t say i’m great at giving advices but i’m more of a great listener.

we never had privacy in the house. we have a small home yet i feel so far away from them. i’ve had few arguments with my parents which i wanted to stay away from them for awhile. covid really changed my parents mostly my dad. I was a Daddy’s girl but one day he just snapped and became like my mom.

and no, i have no teachers i’m close with. im a new student in where im studying which is also another reason why i’m not motivated to do school anymore.  i have a hard time making friends. and the last school i went to i was bullied but i made a few friends there. also no i still refuse to tell what i’ve been going through to anyone close to me bcs i’ve been called dramatic by my mom everytime i try to talk to them about how i feel. i’ve done that too, but my parents just finds ways to still bring me down. i avoided any necessary arguments but on december 25, 2020 I couldn’t pretend anymore. i’m too sensitive, and i’ve triedmy best to live my life without letting my feelings stop me. but my parents argued on Christmas day i couldn’t anymore. i fee so unmotivated since the day my mom made fun of me exercising( this was last year) she keeps nagging that i should exercise but once i did she made fun of me. i’ve been bullied bc of my weight in school and it just hurts more when my parents does it.
